title: Rick & Morty Explain Firewalls vs IDS #Cybersecurity
caption: Ever wondered how firewalls and IDS keep your network safe? Let Rick and Morty break it down! 🚀🔥 #TechExplainers

scenes.script: Alright, Morty, let's talk about firewalls. Imagine a bouncer at the door of your network—only lets in cool people and kicks out the losers.
So, like... a firewall decides who gets in based on some rules? That sounds... complicated, Rick.
scenes.character_image: volume/resources/LoreLabs/images/morty/morty looking to another side without caring.png

scenes.script: Exactly! It's like a nightclub. If you're not on the list or look shady, you're out. No questions asked.
Got it. But what about an IDS? Does it also throw people out?
Not quite, Morty. An IDS is like a security camera inside the club, watching for shady behavior and alerting the bouncer if something's off.
Oh! So it doesn't block anything itself?
scenes.character_image: volume/resources/LoreLabs/images/morty/morty with a dumb looking without understanding.png

scenes.script: Right. It's like having a detective inside—no power to arrest, but can call the cops if needed. Firewall blocks, IDS reports.
What about an IPS? Is it like a security guard that can actually arrest people?
scenes.character_image: volume/resources/LoreLabs/images/morty/morty super angry biting his lips and frowning.png

scenes.script: Bingo! Intrusion Prevention System (IPS) blocks threats in real-time. It's like the bouncer who also throws out troublemakers himself.
So, firewall says 'stay out,' IDS says 'hey, something's wrong,' and IPS says 'get out now'?
scenes.character_image: volume/resources/LoreLabs/images/morty/morty looking to another side without caring.png

scenes.script: Exactly. It's like a three-step security system—first line, second line, and third line. All working together but with different jobs.
Wow... so without them, my network is like a house with no locks? That's terrifying!

topic: What is the difference between a firewall and a intrusion detection system?
